summary: Scratch-pad sample for the AI agent — part of the ai-core plugin bundle
description:
Worked example for ai-core. A chat panel over a browser-only scratch pad, on the bundled mock provider, with no API key. Copy the pattern into your site. Do not import these tools.

Installs with the @jpulse-net/plugin-ai-core bundle. Disable this plugin to hide /hello-ai/, its nav entry, and its dashboard card. AI stays on.

Do not install this plugin separately; it is part of the @jpulse-net/plugin-ai-core bundle.
author: jPulse Team <team@jpulse.net>

schema.content:
Hello AI is the scratch-pad sample that ships with the AI bundle. It is not a product. Copy the pattern into your site; do not import these tools.

  • Hello AI — scratch pad, no API key
  • Hello AI guide — what the demo shows and how to disable it
  • AI Core guide — the site-facing contract
  • Plugin management — disable this plugin to hide the demo; AI stays on
